Immigration Reform Bill discussion
in US Congress
*401. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
an Immigration Reform Bill is likely to be
discussed in the US Congress which may
raise the hope of an increase in employment
based immigration visas and temporary
skilled workers visas; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Competitive edge to post offices
*402. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the share of
post offices in collection, transmission and
delivery of mail, money transfer and various
financial services has declined over the
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken to provide competitive
edge to post offices in the country?
Promotion of sports and sportsmen
*403. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the special package and facilities
envisaged to promote and enhance the skills
of Indian Players and Sportsmen except
usual and conventional practices that are in
existence at present;
(b) the policy initiative to promote and
project Sports and Games in general and in
respect of few games and sports in particular
having good deal of prospects in India; and
(c) whether it is a fact that most of

126
outstanding players and sportsmen have
reached their zenith on account of their own
rather than the environment and the facilities
offered to them by Governmental agency?
Providing computers in village post
offices of Uttaranchal
*404. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to provide modern and effective computers
in all post offices located in the villages and
hilly areas of Uttaranchal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Availability of telephone equipments
 *405. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL  APTE:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
estimate regarding requirement of telephone
equipments for providing landline and
mobile telephone connections in the urban
and rural areas of Chhattisgarh, Madhya
Pradesh, Maharashtra and U.P.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken to ensure availability
of telephone equipments to exhaust the
waiting list; and
(d) the time by when the connections
on demand are likely to be provided?
Quality of MTNL and BSNL mobile
services
†*406.  SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
in comparison to mobile services of other
private companies the mobile services of
MTNL and BSNL are lagging behind,
quality-wise;
(b) whether Government have given any
attention to this fact that the roaming
facility is available in the public cellular
service but due to lack of clarity in voice,
frequent interruption or disturbance in the
network, difficulty in making calls has
become a regular feature; and
(c) the measures contemplated by
Government for bringing improvement in
their mobile services in comparison to other
companies and by when these measures
will be implemented alongwith the details
thereof?
Installation of de-duping software
*407. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have directed telecom operators to install
de-duping software by August, 2006 to
uncover multiple connections;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action proposed to be taken
against operators who do not comply with
the instructions within the prescribed date?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

127
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Programmes on farmers on DD
*408. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROADCAST-
ING be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the programmes
concerning farmers on DD;
(b) Government's response of such
programmes;
(c) whether Government have evaluated
their reach and contents, etc. recently; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
IHSDP in Orissa
*409. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR :
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
the Integrated Housing and Slum
Development Programme (IHSDP) to
ameliorate the conditions of urban slum
dwellers;
(b) the details of the projects that have
since been approved indicating those falling
in the State of Orissa; and
(c) the details of funds that have since
been released for the projects in Orissa
State?
Small towns under AUWSP
in Assam
*410. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the actual number of small towns
having safe drinking water supply under
Accelerated Urban Water Supply
Programme (AUWSP) so far;
(b) the number of such cities in Assam
that have already been covered and the ones
that are yet to be covered under the same
programme;
(c) whether all the district headquarter
towns would be provided with safe
drinking water supply facility in the
country; and
(d) if so, by when is it likely to be
completed?
Loss of stamp duty and registration
fee
†*411. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether State Governments are
suffering losses of stamp duty and
registration fee because of no agreement by
coal companies with State Governments;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to check this loss; and
(c) the efforts being made to solve the
coal related problems and to establish better
co-ordination between Union and State
Governments?
Construction of a bridge under
SARDP in Assam
*412. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal for the construction of a
bridge over Gabhoru river at Missamari in
Sonitpur district of Assam when this bridge
is very important from military movement
point of view also;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
total outlay, annual allocation and target
set;
(c) if not, the present status with steps
taken for the construction of this bridge
under Special Accelerated Road

128
Development Programme (SARDP) for
NER; and
(d) whether it is a fact that this bridge is
being constructed through PWD,
Government of Assam?
Death of employees/jawans deployed
in Indian Embassies
†*413. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been any case of
death of employees/jawans/officials
deployed in Indian Embassies located in
foreign countries including Nepal, Pakistan
and Afghanistan, during the last three years
till date;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
conducted any inquiry in each case; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Enhancement in the cost of project on
Delhi-Gurgaon Expressway
†*414. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the date when construction of the
28 kilometre long expressway from Rao
Tula Ram Marg in Delhi to Gurgaon was
started alongwith the date of its completion;
(b) the total cost of this project
alongwith the enhanced amount of its cost
in terms of rupees in crores;
(c) whether frequent modifications were
made in the project;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the name of the company by whom
the construction work of this project is
being undertaken?
Recruitment programmes for SCs/STs
†*415. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are conducting
special recruitment programmes for SCs/STs;
(b) whether in this context a letter has
been written on the 9th September, 2005 to
all the Ministries on behalf of the Prime
Minister;
(c) whether Government intend to fill
up 80 per cent of all vacant posts of SCs/
STs by December, 2005 and upto 100 per
cent of the same by December, 2006;
(d) whether Government also intend to
adopt the course of direct  recruitment and
promotion to implement the above;
(e) if so, the achievement made so far in
this regard; and
(f) whether State Governments have
been issued any guidelines in this regard
and if so, the results thereof?
Proper utilization of manpower
*416. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
more staff in Doordarshan comparing to
other private channels in the modern
satellite age;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and steps
taken or proposed to be taken for the proper
utilization of manpower;
(c) whether it is a fact that there are
huge numbers of casual labour working in
Doordarshan since more than 10 years to
30 years and they are waiting for their
permanent appointment in Doordarshan;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's view thereon?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Construction of a complex for All
India Panchayat Association in Delhi
*417. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
construct central office cum multi-purpose
complex for All India Panchayat
Association in Delhi on the land owned by
Balvantrai Memorial Trust;
(b) if so, the present status of above
proposal including area of the land identified,
the details of the project submitted and grant/
financial aid, marked/identified, if any;
(c) whether the above trust had taken
any decision for concurring with the above
proposal;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the details of the present utility and
the control of above land?
Telecasting of amusing serials
*418. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) the details of serials telecast on
Doordarshan National Channel daily
dealing with the family life;
(b) the number of episodes of such
serials granted for telecast and how far such
serials have adverse effect on the life of
common/businessman;
(c) the reasons for granting such long
serials on National Channel of  Doordarshan;
and
(d) by when only amusing serials shall
be introduced on the National Channel
instead of such long and boring serials?
Telephone service providers in urban
and rural areas
*419. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether private service providers
are not interested to extend their telephone
services in rural areas;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government propose to
make it mandatory for all service providers
to extend their services in rural areas;
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard; and
(e) the percentage of telephone services
provided in urban areas as compared to
rural areas during the last five years?
Repayment of loan by NHAI
*420. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the total toll and money collected
by NHAI during the year 2004-05;
(b) the interest paid by NHAI in
2004-05 on loans taken;
(c) the loans repaid by NHAI in
2004-05;
(d) the steps NHAI propose to take to
ensure better utilisation of loans; and
(e) the steps proposed by NHAI to
build roads, economically?

Setting up of a Coal Videsh Ltd.
2879. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has decided
to move ahead with plan to allow Coal
India Ltd. to set up a new subsidiary
company Coal Videsh Ltd. for acquiring
coal blocks abroad;
(b) if so, whether Ministry of Finance
had objected to this proposal and
suggested that Coal India itself should do
the acquisition;
(c) whether the Union Cabinet has
given its approval to the proposal; and
(d) if so, by when a final decision in
this regard is likely to be taken?
E-auction leading to fall in coal prices
†2880. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the price of
coal is continuously decreasing after the
implementation of e-auction system for sale
of coal;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government intend to put
in place any alternative system for sale of
coal, if so, the details thereof?
Fly ash from thermal power plants
†2881. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether fly ash emitting from
thermal power plants is being used in coal
mines in Orissa;

666

(b) whether this experiment has been
successful;
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider using the fly ash emitting from
thermal power plants in other coal mines
also; and
(d) if so, by when a decision would be
taken in this regard?
Coal production and gap between
demand and supply
2882. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) the total production of coal in the
country both by Coal India Ltd. and other
captive mines;
(b) the present demands of coal in the
country; and
(c) the details of Government
programme to fill up the gap between
demand and supply?
Import of coal
†2883. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that coal import
in the country is expected to be doubled
from the year 2001-02 to 2006-07;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether the domestic production of
coal has also increased during the said
periods; and
(d) if so, the percentage of this increase?
AIIMS like hospital at Kolkata by CIL
2884. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
DR. BARUN MUKHERJEE:
SHRI MOINUL HASSAN:
SHRI SAMAN PATHAK:
SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the year
2004, Coal India Limited decided to set up
an AIIMS type hospital at Kolkata;
(b) the amount of money has been spent
so far for this project (Head of Account
wise); and
(c) the present status of this project?
Bilateral agreements in coal sectors
2885. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India is on the threshold of
announcing several key bilateral agreements
in the coal sector aimed to set off strategic
public-private partnerships with global
firms;
(b) if so, the details thereof and their
present status;
(c) whether India is pitching for a strong
position in clean coal technologies to
enhance its use as a dominant energy
source, and the multilateral dialogues to
develop the coal sector are progressing at a
fast pace with action-plans for cooperation
on13-14 projects likely to be finalized
shortly; and

667
(d) if so, the details thereof and their
present status?
Coal blocks allotted to private
companies
2886. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new coal blocks have
been allotted to private sector companies
during the last two years for mining; and
(b) the names of the corporate sectors
to whom the land has been allotted in acres,
period of lease and conditions of allotment
such as social sector obligations for the area,
jobs for the locals, compensation for the
displaced etc.?
Import of coal
2887. SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is
projected to import about 44 million tonnes
of coal this year, despite the fact that the
country is sitting on indicated reserves of a
whopping 252 billion tonnes of coal and
proven reserves of 95 billion tonnes;
(b) whether it is a fact that the huge
amount of coal imports point to the
inability of Government owned Coal India
Ltd. (CIL) and Singareni Collieries to exploit
the country's natural resources; and
(c) if so, whether Government have
made any investigations in this regard?
Haphazard mining in Meghalaya
2888. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the town
Ladrymbai in Meghalaya is sitting on a
rabbit warren of crisscrossing tunnels due
to haphazard mining in the town;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in the
absence of a developmental plan,
supportive infrastructure, knowledge and
skills, communities here have engaged in
uncontrolled gouging of the earth; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to prevent the social disruption and
environmental devastation at Ladrymbai in
Meghalaya?
Preference to big companies

RAO:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI AJAY MAROO:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government would extend
preferential treatment to big firms in the
matter of allotment of captive coal mines;
(b) if so, the details of the policy;
(c) the reasons for deliberately being
harsh to small units therefor;
(d) whether a preferential policy would
create monopolies, which are sustained by
Government owned mines; and
(e) the steps proposed to review the
policy?
Merger of ITI with BSNL and MTNL
2890. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some of the
six units of the ITI did not have enough
work and that the available orders could
not be executed for want of working capital;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

668
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether it is also a fact that a demand
has been received by Government to merge
the ITI with the BSNL and MTNL to
overcome the problems of ITI; and
(d) if so, Government's views in this
regard?
Introduction of local calls between
Metropolitan Cities
†2891. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION

(a) whether calls between Delhi and
Mumbai have become local, w.e.f. 1st June,
2006;
(b) if so, the amount of increase per
mensem in MTNL income on account of
that;
(c) whether in view of success of this
scheme Government propose to introduce
this scheme in other Metropolis as well;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Telecom network in Orissa
2892. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of revenue villages in the
country that are connected with the telecom
network especially in Orissa;
(b) the steps Government are taking to
improve the tele-density of rural areas in
different States especially in Orissa;
(c) whether there is any time frame to
complete all villages of Orissa as telecom
network connected village; and
(d) if so, the targeted period therefor?
SEZs by Infosys
2893. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Infosys propose to set up
five SEZs with $400 million budget;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such a Special Zone is also
proposed to be located in Orissa State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Shortage of pre-paid mobile
connections of MTNL and BSNL
2894. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government is aware
that scarcity of the pre-paid mobile
connections of MTNL and BSNL;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons therefor and number of
applications that are pending together with
the State-wise break-up?
Waiting lists of telephone in Rajasthan
2895. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the current status of the waiting lists

on date;

(c) the time-frame within which these
waiting lists would be cleared; and
(d) the details of plan for extension of
telephone network in Rajasthan?
STD/ISD/PCO booths in Rajasthan
2896. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND

pleased to state:
(a) the number of STD/ISD/PCO
booths set up in Rajasthan during the last
three years;
(b) the number of such booths proposed
to be set up in the State during the year
2006-07; and
(c) the details of funds allocated
therefor?
Spectrum allocation to new terrestrial
services
2897. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Department
of Space in a communication to Telecom
Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has
recently stated that it was using its orbits
spectrum resources to provide various
services such as telecommunications,
Radio, Village Resources Centre and this
must be taken into account before making
any Spectrum allocation to new terrestrial
services and applications in frequency
bands that are already being used by Indian
Satellite Systems;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the reaction of the
Department of Telecommunications
thereto?
Issue of statements through post
offices to Senior Citizens
2898. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Senior Citizens who have opened their
accounts under Senior Citizen Saving
Schemes have to wait for hours together in a
long queue for their statements making their
life miserable and tiresome on due dates;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to issue such statements
through the various post offices desired by
them; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Conversion of postal department into
commercial department
†2899. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to establish the postal department
commercially;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) the role of Government officials in
such move and Government's view in this
regard; and

670
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) the steps taken by Government so
that postal department can cash maximum
income alongwith fulfilling the social
responsibilities?
Release of telephone connections in
Muzaffarnagar
†2900. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of applicants in waiting
list for telephone connections in the district
Muzaffarnagar of Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the time it take for giving telephone
connections after getting approval; and
(c) the steps taken by Government for
giving the connections expeditiously?
Cell to deal with public complaints
2901. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been any cell to
deal with the complainants on grievances
of the public in regard to private cellular
companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Compensation to courier companies
2902. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to ban
all small courier companies from delivering
post;
(b) if so, the details of the proposed
ban;
(c) whether there is a proposal to take
over small courier companies employing
thousands of youths;
(d) the compensation would be paid to
such companies and their employees who
are banned from their occupation; and
(e) the details thereof?
Mumbai blasts
†2903. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Pakistan has
